title: Fix typos and unclear sentences in the Session 1 notes
body:
## Problem
The Session 1 notes may contain typos or sentences that a first-year student finds confusing.

## Context
Beginners judge the whole repo by Session 1.

## Expected outcome
A clearer `sessions/session-01/README.md` and `lesson.py` comments.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`, `sessions/session-01/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At least three improvements
- [ ] `python start.py test` still passes

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add a real LDR data sheet comparison to Session 1
body:
## Problem
The LDR curve in Session 1 is assumed and illustrative; learners do not see how a real data sheet compares.

## Context
QUALITY.md asks that the model is clearly distinguished from real behaviour.

## Expected outcome
A short note (with a source link and the data-sheet resistance at 10 lux and the gamma it implies) and a plot of the real curve next to the model.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/lesson.py`, `sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Source cited, values labelled as from the data sheet
- [ ] Plot has labelled axes with units

## Difficulty
beginner

title: Add Session 4: fade the LED in and out
body:
## Problem
The roadmap's second milestone does not exist yet.

## Context
See `promo/roadmap.md`. The Target fades the LED over ten minutes instead of switching it in one step.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-04/` with README (sections A to F), lesson, checkpoint, exercises and app in the same style as Sessions 1 to 3.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`, `sessions/session-03/lesson.py`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Checkpoint prints PASS and the largest one-minute brightness step is at most 0.1
- [ ] Added to the tests

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Add a debounce-timer controller to Session 3
body:
## Problem
Session 3 cures chatter only with hysteresis; many real controllers use a time delay.

## Context
Roadmap milestone 1.

## Expected outcome
A `debounce` function and a comparison with the Schmitt trigger on several seeded days.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-03/lesson.py`, `promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] At most 2 switches on the seed 7 day with zero hysteresis
- [ ] Checkpoint added

## Difficulty
intermediate

title: Reproduce the Target: three controllers on one cloudy day
body:
## Problem
The Target animation shows a single-threshold comparator, a Schmitt trigger and a fading Schmitt trigger on one noisy day; there is no public implementation.

## Context
The code behind the Target is private on purpose. The roadmap gives the path.

## Expected outcome
Your own implementation, written from the roadmap, plus an animation like the Target.

## Relevant files
`promo/roadmap.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] Single threshold chatters, Schmitt switches twice, fade steps at most 0.1 per minute
- [ ] Short write-up of your method

## Difficulty
advanced

title: Translate the Session 1 notes into Hindi
body:
## Problem
Students who prefer Hindi cannot read Session 1 comfortably.

## Context
This project teaches first- and second-year students across India; translations widen who can join.

## Expected outcome
`sessions/session-01/README.hi.md` with a faithful Hindi translation of sections A to F, linked from the main README.

## Relevant files
`sessions/session-01/README.md`

## Acceptance criteria
- [ ] All sections translated
- [ ] Equations, code blocks and file names unchanged
- [ ] Link added to the main README

## Difficulty
beginner
